class_notes_reviewer.START/s: ANALYTIC for authorized/not-authorized. The sub-value 'permission-only' (R-79) is a synthetic link. Several 'not-authorized' values were produced by applying unstated synthetic rules during coding (R-81 freeze).

class_notes_reviewer.REGISTER/k: SYNTHETIC but untested. The only contrast has a PERFORMED side that is the rule statement '(rule)', not an observed act.
